metadata.description: Personal Claude Code plugin marketplace (fork). Custom plugins on top of claude-code-templates.

plugins.name: pre-push-review
plugins.description: Fires an expert panel of code reviewers before every git push and blocks the push on critical findings. Portable, versioned — no per-machine hand-wiring.

plugins.name: quality-kernel
plugins.description: A quality-assurance kernel for agentic development: a six-agent SwarmForge-style engine (specifier -> coder -> cleaner -> architect -> hardener -> QA) with deterministic quality tools, a blind live-oracle verifier, epistemic-discipline gates, and a deterministic quality gate (/gate).

plugins.name: spa-kit
plugins.description: A factory for client SPAs that classic search crawlers and AI answer engines can both read. Generates a standalone Next.js site from a declarative brief, derives the whole OKLCH palette from one brand hex with enforced contrast targets, and verifies it with three independent oracles: a no-JavaScript crawler probe, a blind breaker, and a Playwright suite (visual, a11y, motion contract, web vitals). Includes the /spa-kit interview skill.

plugins.name: pr-draft-guard
plugins.description: Rule + hook: every pull request Claude opens is a draft; Claude never merges or un-drafts one, and asks before merging a base branch into a feature branch.

plugins.name: aws-admin-guard
plugins.description: Rule + hooks: the AWS admin profile is usable only after the human authorizes it and confirms a second time in two separate typed messages; consent is read from the session transcript and expires.

plugins.name: chat-language-guard
plugins.description: Rule + hooks: Claude talks to the user in Spanish while code, commits, PRs and files stay English; a Stop check sends English replies back for a Spanish rewrite.
